interpretation.rationale: A network visualization with sponsors as one node type and drugs as another will show which sponsors are testing which drugs in melanoma trials.

Cyclophosphamide: tumor antigen loaded autologous dendritic cells
Questionnaires: Health Related Quality of Life Questionnaires (HRQoL)

assumptions: Edge weight = number of trials that list both entities; node size = trials listing the entity.
Placebo, saline and standard-of-care arms are excluded from drug nodes.
Name variants were merged into 939 canonical entities using the records' own otherNames and MeSH terms (see statistics.entity_merges); citations quote the original spelling.
